propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled by inferring class from structural signals: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event → regression, plan-review BLOCK verdict → plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR record → env_integration, otherwise → undetermined

Backfilled records are written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson (git-tracked via .gitignore negation) with source=backfill_classified, confidence=classified, and are segregated from authoritative close_class values
The backfill script is idempotent: it skips bugs already present in the artifact or already carrying close_class; re-runs append no duplicates

REVERT signal must target substantive event types (STATUS or COMMITS), not COMMENT/LINK; only raw event-file scan (not all_review_results) detects gate_error_v1 on REVIEW_RESULT/COMPLETION_VERDICT streams
Bugs already carrying authoritative close_class are never overwritten; only bugs with absent close_class are eligible for backfill
All backfilled records carry is_authoritative()=False, proving complete segregation from authoritative series and enabling safe downstream filtering
